CommunityNeed.description: Who lives in a site's catchment, from Census data (Python-computed, population-weighted).
CommunityNeed.title: CommunityNeed

DatasetCandidate.description: Proposed by a dataset-scout for one factor.
DatasetCandidate.title: DatasetCandidate

DemandModel.description:
Who the customers are, who competes and what space fits: written by the business profiler, validated in
Python against the grid. Healthcare presets derive it from their pack.
DemandModel.title: DemandModel

DemandSegment.description: One group of people who are this business's customers, measured by a grid feature.
DemandSegment.title: DemandSegment

Factor.description: Written by the factor-analyst. One thing that makes a new office succeed for this practice.
Factor.title: Factor

FeatureSpec.description:
Declarative recipe that geo-service runs to turn a dataset into one value per H3 cell.

Never contains code. Filtering uses filter_column/filter_values only.
FeatureSpec.title: FeatureSpec

PracticeProfile.description: Intake for any business (the name is historical). Healthcare fills specialty/payers; others business_type.
PracticeProfile.title: PracticeProfile

RankRequest.description: geo POST /rank: net-new, site quality, final score and (optionally) stability in one call.
RankRequest.title: RankRequest

RegionFeature.description: A feature already available in a region's feature store.
RegionFeature.title: RegionFeature

SiteInspection.description:
What the site-inspector checked for one space, combining CoStar (listing), Vexcel (aerial) and Matterport (3D).
Every number comes from those APIs or the listing; findings are rendered by Python from these values.
SiteInspection.title: SiteInspection
